instNote: ﻿Last June, 5 professed sisters were sent from this community to establish a foundation of their order in the city of St. Louis. Amongst the various spiritual and corporal works of mercy, those peculiarly characteristic of this institution are, "Instruction of Poor Girls"; "Visitation of the Sick"; and "Protection of Young Women of Good Character"... The sisters visit the sick and dying poor every day, also Belleview Hospital and the City Prison twice a week. Adults, requiring religious instruction, are daily attended to in the institution.
